cases.sentence: ___ рос и набирался сил и мудрости, и милость Божия была на нем.
cases.translation: The child grew and became strong and wise, and the grace of God was upon him.
cases.explain: Ребёнок is the subject of рос (was growing) → nominative.

cases.sentence: она родила своего первенца, запеленала его и положила в кормушку для ___.
cases.translation: She gave birth to her firstborn, wrapped him, and laid him in a feeding trough for livestock.
cases.explain: The preposition для (for) takes the genitive → скота.

cases.sentence: Мария и Иосиф понесли младенца в Иерусалим, чтобы посвятить его ___.
cases.translation: Mary and Joseph brought the child to Jerusalem to dedicate him to the Lord.
cases.explain: Посвятить X кому-то (to dedicate X to someone) puts the recipient in the dative → Господу.

cases.sentence: она родила своего ___, запеленала его и положила в кормушку для скота.
cases.translation: She gave birth to her firstborn, wrapped him, and laid him in a feeding trough for livestock.
cases.explain: Первенца is the direct object of родила (gave birth to) → accusative. Первенец is animate, so its accusative matches the genitive form.

cases.sentence: Он был праведен и благочестив и с ___ ожидал того, кто принесет утешение для Израиля.
cases.translation: He was righteous and devout, and with hope he waited for the one who would bring consolation to Israel.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with, accompaniment) takes the instrumental → надеждой.

cases.sentence: В ___ в это время был человек, которого звали Симеоном.
cases.translation: There was a man in Jerusalem at that time whose name was Simeon.
cases.explain: В (in), marking location, takes the prepositional → Иерусалиме.

reading.ru: Иосиф тоже пошел из галилейского города Назарета в Иудею, в город Давида, называемый Вифлеем, потому что он был потомком Давида.
reading.question: Why did Joseph travel to Bethlehem?
options: Because he was a descendant of David and had to register there
Because Herod ordered him to hide there
Because there was a wedding to attend
reading.correct: Because he was a descendant of David and had to register there
reading.explain: Joseph went to Bethlehem, the city of David, because he was descended from David and had to register for the census.

reading.ru: В Вифлееме у Марии подошло время родов, и она родила своего первенца, запеленала его и положила в кормушку для скота, потому что для них не нашлось места в гостинице.
reading.question: Where did Mary lay her newborn son, and why?
options: In a feeding trough, because there was no room at the inn
In a golden cradle at the temple
In a basket by the river
In a tent outside the city walls
reading.correct: In a feeding trough, because there was no room at the inn
reading.explain: Mary laid her firstborn in a feeding trough for livestock because there was no room for them in the inn.

reading.ru: Вдруг перед ними предстал ангел Господа, окруженный сиянием Господней славы. Пастухи очень испугались
reading.question: How did the shepherds react when the angel appeared to them?
reading.explain: When the angel of the Lord appeared before them in glory, the shepherds were terrified.

reading.ru: Сегодня в городе Давида родился ваш Спаситель, Христос, Господь.
reading.question: What news did the angel bring to the shepherds?
options: A Savior, Christ the Lord, was born in the city of David
A new king had been crowned in Jerusalem
reading.correct: A Savior, Christ the Lord, was born in the city of David
reading.explain: The angel announced that a Savior, Christ the Lord, had been born in the city of David.

reading.ru: «Слава Богу, вышине небес! А на земле мир людям, которым он благоволит».
reading.question: What did the heavenly host proclaim?
options: "Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace to those he favors"
"The Messiah will come in a thousand years"
reading.correct: "Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace to those he favors"
reading.explain: The heavenly host praised God, saying, "Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace to those he favors."

reading.ru: Они поспешили туда и нашли Марию, Иосифа и младенца, лежащего в кормушке для скота.
reading.question: What did the shepherds find when they hurried to Bethlehem?
options: Mary, Joseph, and the baby lying in the feeding trough
Only Joseph, since Mary had already left
reading.correct: Mary, Joseph, and the baby lying in the feeding trough
reading.explain: The shepherds hurried and found Mary, Joseph, and the baby lying in the feeding trough.

reading.ru: На восьмой день, когда пришло время совершить над ним обряд обрезания, его назвали Иисусом, именем, которое ангел дал ему еще до того, как он был зачат.
reading.question: What happened on the eighth day after Jesus's birth?
options: He was circumcised and named Jesus
He was presented to King Herod
reading.correct: He was circumcised and named Jesus
reading.explain: On the eighth day the child was circumcised and named Jesus, the name given by the angel before he was conceived.

reading.ru: Симеон взял его на руки и благословил Бога, сказав, «Владыка, как ты и обещал, теперь ты отпускаешь своего слугу с миром, потому что мои глаза увидели спасение твое,
reading.question: What did Simeon do when he took the baby Jesus in his arms?
options: He blessed God, saying he could now depart in peace
He wept and refused to let go
He asked to speak with the priests
reading.correct: He blessed God, saying he could now depart in peace
reading.explain: Simeon took the child in his arms and blessed God, saying he could now depart in peace as promised.

reading.ru: Да и тебе самой меч пронзит душу.
reading.question: What did Simeon prophesy to Mary?
options: A sword would pierce her own soul
She would never see Jesus again
She would live to be very old
reading.correct: A sword would pierce her own soul
reading.explain: Simeon told Mary that a sword would pierce her own soul as well.

reading.ru: Она была в глубокой старости. Анна прожила семь лет со своим мужем, а всю остальную жизнь она жила вдовой.
reading.question: What do we learn about the prophetess Anna?
options: She was very old, had been married seven years, then lived as a widow
She was a young virgin like Mary
She was the wife of Simeon
reading.correct: She was very old, had been married seven years, then lived as a widow
reading.explain: Anna was very old, having lived seven years with her husband and then as a widow the rest of her life.

reading.ru: Через три дня они нашли мальчика в храме. Он сидел среди учителей, слушал их и задавал вопросы.
reading.question: Where did Mary and Joseph find the twelve-year-old Jesus after three days of searching?
options: In the temple, sitting among the teachers, listening and asking questions
reading.correct: In the temple, sitting among the teachers, listening and asking questions
reading.explain: After three days they found Jesus in the temple, sitting among the teachers, listening to them and asking questions.

reading.ru: Разве вы не знали, что я должен быть в том, что принадлежит отцу моему?
reading.question: How did Jesus answer his parents when they found him in the temple?
options: He asked if they didn't know he must be in his Father's house
He apologized and promised never to wander off again
He said he was waiting for a teacher to arrive
He said he was hiding from Herod's soldiers
reading.correct: He asked if they didn't know he must be in his Father's house
reading.explain: Jesus asked his parents whether they didn't know he had to be about his Father's business.
